game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Dam Filler: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the level value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the supply cache using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Dam Filler
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Dam Filler' (Week 4 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 22.
